1983-12-30: New Mexico Lobos beat Bowling Green Falcons 86–74 as Alan Dolensky scored a team-high 21. David Jenkins had 24 for Bowling Green Falcons.
1983-12-20: Bowling Green Falcons beat Ohio State Buckeyes 70–64. David Jenkins led the winners with 24 points. Tony Campbell had 23 for Ohio State Buckeyes. Tony Campbell grabbed 16 rebounds.
